name: OPIS
summary: 以输入图像中的固定对象实例检验生成回放的对象保持、身份与结构。
summaryEn: Tests generated-rollout object presence, identity and structure against fixed input-image instances.
scaleZh: 500 个案例；12,672 个对象实例
access: Official documentation provides data access instructions; download not tested
accessZh: 官方文档提供数据访问说明；未实测下载
license: Consult publisher terms; data license not independently verified
licenseZh: 请核对发布方条款；数据许可尚未独立核实
wmNote: 输入包含静态图像，入选依据是明确的时序保持评测协议；上游素材并非独立采集。
wmNoteEn: Inputs include still images; admission rests on the explicit temporal-persistence protocol, and upstream assets are not independently collected.

evidence.locator: Dataset summary; Sources and construction; Evaluation artifacts
evidence.statement: The release anchors rollout evaluation to an annotated initial object inventory, then measures presence, identity and structural persistence with visibility reasoning and static/dynamic tracks. This is a dedicated world-model memory protocol.
